hero.description: Product Design, 3D Printing, Mold Design & Manufacturing Consulting.

about.headline: A design and manufacturing atelier — not a print shop.
about.description1: 100KRAFT sits between the drawing board and the production line. We shape products with the discipline of industrial design and the constraints of real manufacturing held in the same hand — geometry, material, tooling and cost resolved together rather than in sequence.
about.description2: Every concept that leaves the atelier is manufacturable. We prove it in resin, filament and metal before a single mold is cut.

contact.headlineStart: Tell us what you want to
contact.description: Working with clients across Europe and the Middle East. Send a brief, a sketch or a CAD file — we reply within two working days.

footer.description: Product Design · 3D Printing · Mold Design · Manufacturing

services.description: Six disciplines, one continuous workflow. A project can enter at any point and leave as a manufacturable product.

productDesign.title: Product Design
productDesign.desc: Translating user requirements and technical constraints into a cohesive product architecture, balancing aesthetics with assembly logic.

design3d.title: 3D Design
design3d.desc: Class-A surfacing and parametric solid modeling ready for downstream engineering, rendering and simulation.

printing3d.title: 3D Printing
printing3d.desc: In-house polymer printing to validate scale, ergonomics and snap-fits overnight.

prototyping.title: Rapid Prototyping
prototyping.desc: Finished models mixing CNC machining, casting and painting for investor pitches and user testing.

moldDesign.title: Mold Design
moldDesign.desc: Design for Manufacture (DFM) covering draft angles, parting lines, cooling channels and ejection strategies.

consulting.title: Manufacturing Consulting
consulting.desc: Sourcing, cost optimization and supplier qualification to bridge the gap between a prototype and mass production.

p1.story: A cordless handheld built around a single-piece housing. We cut part count from 22 to 11, then engineered the tooling so the transparent chamber could be molded without a secondary operation.

p2.story: A machined instrument body developed from clay study to anodised production part, with the grip geometry validated across nine printed iterations.

p3.story: Soft-touch beige housing with a copper control detail. Process selection and supplier qualification brought unit cost down 31% before the first production run.

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: Brief, users, constraints, target cost. We define what the product must survive before we draw it.

design.title: Design
design.body: Form exploration in sketch and clay logic, then resolved surfaces and a full CAD assembly.

prototype.title: Prototype
prototype.body: Printed in the workshop within days — looks-like and works-like samples in engineering materials.

validate.title: Validate
validate.body: Fit, tolerance, drop, thermal and assembly checks. Iterations continue until the part behaves.

manufacture.title: Manufacture
manufacture.body: Tooling design, supplier qualification and pilot run supervision through to steady production.

workshop.headline: A fabrication laboratory, three metres from the drawing board.
workshop.description: Design and production share one roof in Antalya. A geometry change in the morning is a part in hand by afternoon — which is why our iterations are measured in hours instead of weeks.

eq2.name: Materials
eq2.desc: PA12, ASA, PC, TPU, resin, carbon-filled

expertise.headline: Design decisions that survive the production line.

i1.title: Injection Molding
i1.body: Tool layout, gating and cooling designed with the part, plus draft, shrinkage and wall-thickness resolved before steel is cut.

i2.title: Manufacturing Optimization
i2.body: Cycle-time, part consolidation and process selection reviewed against volume so unit cost falls without touching perceived quality.

i3.title: Product Development
i3.body: End-to-end ownership from brief to pilot run, including supplier qualification, sample approval and production documentation.
